description: Russia, P2 tier of the 2026-10-25 upper-level research (HOI4 1936 candidates): area caps 15,000 / 25,000 / 35,000 / 45,000 km², convex-hull fill ≥ 0.4, aspect ≤ 3.5; city hosts protected for capitals, major cities and at least 500,000 people. Scoped to blank, HOI4 1936/1939 and Modern World, the readers of the HOI4 vanilla releasable catalog; HOI4 states and river-paint packs apply. Parcels of the shared historical display presets stay unmerged. Two candidates are left out: they would cut a releasable boundary of the vanilla catalog.
